html:
Greetings, Agents.


This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.

 

In this patch, we’re introducing another Silver Surfer, 
the White Queen, and the Flora colossi.

 

Emma Frost and Groot, enjoying a cool beach vacation to beat the summer heat, 
are getting a Tier-4 Advancement and a New Uniform.

 

Additionally, Silver Surfer (Shalla-Bal), 
Galactus’s herald, who announces the doom of targeted planets,
has joined the world of MARVEL Future Fight, 
ready with Tier-3 and Tier-4 abilities.

 

Agents, check out the new skills and powers of the updated heroes
by downloading the 7/29 Patch!

 


■ 7/29 Patch Details

 

Patch Schedule: 7/30 (Wed) 3:00 (UTC+0), 7/29 (Tue) 20:00 (PDT)

 

[7/30 (Wed) 2:36 (UTC+0), 7/29 (Tue) 19:36 (PDT) added]
The patch has been completed as of 7/30 (Wed) 2:35 (UTC+0), 7/29 (Tue) 19:35 (PDT).
Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

* The patch completion time may be changed depending on the circumstances.
Completion time will be announced once the patch has been completed.
* The patch will be applied in waves, and the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch.
When the patch is complete, please restart and apply the patch for better service.

 


▣ One New Hero

 

Check out the abilities of Silver Surfer (Shalla-Bal) <Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps>, 

the wielder of cosmic power who started traversing the universe on her board to protect her home world.
* The skill effects of the new hero are based on the maximum skill level stats.

  

 

 

▣ Two New Uniforms

 

Two new Uniforms, Emma Frost <Summer Queen>, 
and Groot <Planet X Palm> have been added.
* The two new Uniforms can be purchased after the 7/29 Patch data has been applied.
* New Uniforms are available for purchase during the Event period.
* Seasonal Uniforms may be available for purchase again 
after the event has been over through similar events or packages.


▶ Emma Frost <Summer Queen>
After the 7/29 Patch - 8/15 (Fri) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 7/29 Patch - 8/15 (Fri) 7:59 (PDT)
- Purchase method: Can be exchanged at the Event Token Shop with ‘2025 Summer Tokens’
- ‘2025 Summer Tokens’ can be acquired by purchasing event products or through other methods
until 8/12 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0) / 7:59 (PDT).
* You can acquire ‘2025 Summer Tokens’ from specific products sold in the Web Shop.
* Please check if tokens are included before making a purchase.
 

▶ 5 new products have been added in the Web Shop.
Sale Period:
7/29 (Tue) 15:00 - 8/12 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0)
7/29 (Tue) 8:00 - 8/12 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
Please visit the Web Shop during this period to check them out.

[Go to - 5 Web Shop Exclusive Products]


▶ Groot <Planet X Palm>
After the 7/29 Patch - 8/12 (Tue) 14:59 (UTC+0),
After the 7/29 Patch - 8/12 (Tue) 7:59 (PDT)
- Purchase method: Crystal purchase (Discount event will not be applied.)

 

* The skill effects of the new Uniforms are based on the maximum skill level stats.

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Silver Surfer (Shalla-Bal) Tier-3 & Tier-4

 

To protect her home world, she voluntarily became Galactus’s herald and gained immense power.
Check out the Silver Surfer (Shalla-Bal)’s Tier-3 Ultimate Skill!

 

 

 

Silver Surfer (Shalla-Bal) has received the Tier-4 advancement.
Through her cosmic power, she has gained not only the strength to subdue enemies but also powerful survivability.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 


▣ Emma Frost & Groot Tier-4

Emma Frost and Groot have received Tier-4 advancements, 
which will help them utilize their organic diamond transformation ability and plant-based physique more effectively.
* The Tier-4 Striker Skill effects are based on Lv.6 stats.

 

 

 


▣ New Artifact

After the July patch, an Exclusive Passive Skill Artifact for Silver Surfer (Shalla-Bal) will be added.
﻿* The skill effects are based on Lv.4 stats.

 

 


▣ New Uniform Collection


Check out the new Uniforms inspired by Marvel Studios’ The Fantastic Four: First Steps.
Complete the collection by achieving the specified conditions and earn a reward.

 

 

 

▣ Game Error Fixes


1. The icon for Ironheart <Marvel Television’s Ironheart> Uniform’s 5th skill has been changed. 


We look forward to your active participation in the events 
that will be held to support the growth of the updated heroes.


Thank you.
